ai_summary: **Executive Summary**  360 ONE WAM Limited demonstrated robust operating performance in Q2 FY27, marked by 17.5% year-on-year growth in operating revenue and a 31% increase in total AUM, primarily driven by strong wealth management flows and higher ARR retention. However, total revenue growth was significantly dampened to 4.8% YoY and PAT declined 4.4% YoY due to a material negative mark-to-market impact of ₹44 crores on treasury investments (linked to the NSE listing), indicating a vulnerability to non-core market fluctuations impacting the bottom line. Strategic initiatives like UBS collaboration and AI platform integration are progressing, alongside continued cost discipline.
